how: The surviving help title calls members to the canvas without preserving the intended task or a visible response.
The black-only instruction recruits members to represent the room through the shared work.
One member maps the plan and another repeats its instruction, supporting a starter role without identifying the first placer.
A competing location proposal receives an explicit correction restoring the earlier representative plan.
The planner reports earlier completion and present rebuilding without providing independent observation of the work.
Members circulate coordinates and image references, repeat the filling boundary, and restore the same plan against a competing proposal.
A posted plan requires a further clarification exchange when a member reports confusion and receives another image.
A short reply assents to the planner's correction without requesting anything or explicitly promising placement.
A competing proposal receives corrective recall of the prior plan and then bare endorsement of the correcting member.
Participants are directed to external venues for updates on the shared plan.

statement: distinguishing external plan updates from unobserved external decisions
how: An invitation to external updates establishes venue routing but cannot establish where decisions were made or whether participants attended.
Include routing participants to external plan updates as a process without requiring evidence that planning or decisions actually moved there.
The planner attributes damage to an outside group and reports rebuilding the earlier work.
The candidate attribution process appears as naming an alleged damaging group without tracing placers or independently verifying responsibility.
Members are told to limit their filling under a stated threat of retaliation without evidence of a negotiated agreement.
A brief pre-close account recalls completion and subsequent damage while explaining the current rebuild.
Music posts become occasions for an April Fools joke response and a late remix gift independently of canvas planning.
A joke response and an April Fools gift support playful framing without establishing fabricated news.
The external update direction and approval of the planner reveal no decision procedure or formal appointment.
Calling an earlier plan more realistic does not itself state a shortage of hands or canvas space.
The rebuilding report leaves methods of placement unspecified.
The warning about a feared neighbour supplies no negotiation or quoted agreement.
The competing corner proposal is redirected to the original coordinates without an observed relocation.
The general help title identifies no other room or exchange of assistance.
External update venues are named without a coalition or joint undertaking.
A warning about a neighbouring group establishes neither host permission nor guest status.
Neither the filling instruction nor the update direction identifies someone carrying a proposal between rooms.

Reported prior completion does not reveal whether building prompted a collective completion ritual.
